name: NνDEx
summary: NνDEx develops a high-pressure selenium-hexafluoride time projection chamber for selenium-82 neutrinoless double-beta decay at Jinping. NνDEx-100 denotes the 100-kg gas stage, rather than 100 kg of selenium-82 isotope.
detection_principle: Ionization in electronegative SeF6 forms drifting negative ions. Low-noise Topmetal silicon sensors measure charge without gas avalanche multiplication, allowing energy and event-topology reconstruction.

status.label: Under construction
status.evidence: Design and simulation publications document NνDEx-100 development. The earlier installation target of 2025 is a schedule, not evidence that physics operation has begun.

science_scope: A neutrinoless decay would violate lepton number. Half-life sensitivity is a forecast unless explicitly reported as an experimental limit; its interpretation as an effective Majorana mass depends on the decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.
